stem: Which sentence describes a DIFFERENCE in the authors’ reasons for referencing modern experts in the articles “Counting like the Maya” and “An Ancient Farming Method”?

options.label: A
options.text: The author of “Counting like the Maya” mentions a modern expert to reveal his support for Mayan math in his own words, while the author of “An Ancient Farming Method” mentions modern experts to show how scientists have helped bring terrace farming into the present era.

options.label: B
options.text: The author of “Counting like the Maya” mentions a modern expert to suggest that his is one of many different opinions about Mayan math, while the author of “An Ancient Farming Method” mentions modern experts to suggest that they are generally in agreement about terrace farming.

options.label: C
options.text: The author of “Counting like the Maya” mentions a modern expert to show that it was simple to persuade modern people to adopt Mayan math, while the author of “An Ancient Farming Method” refers to modern experts to show that doing the same for terrace farming was more challenging.

options.label: D
options.text: The author of “Counting like the Maya” mentions a modern expert to suggest that Mayan math deserves more recognition from other professionals in the field, while the author of “An Ancient Farming Method” refers to modern experts to suggest that terrace farming can be used alongside other kinds of farming.
